title: Channel | WhatsApp | Component Rendering | Fallback to Text | Full Flow |
description:
Customer accesses chatbot via WhatsApp. Rich UI components (flight cards, interactive buttons, seat maps) may not render on WhatsApp. System must fall back to text-based alternatives. Per call transcript: "Cards, buttons, dropdowns may not display on WhatsApp." 

Prerequisites:
Channel: WhatsApp; PNR: TCED23; 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; APPR EL-01
